body.brief:
# Trace: "Lara went partying after the concert was cancelled"

Source: Pressfront Trace, trace 01JDEM0RVM0R000000000000CS, https://pressfront.co/trace.html?id=01JDEM0RVM0R000000000000CS.
Window: 2026-08-08 to 2026-11-06.

## The answer
The "Lara went partying after the concert was cancelled" story started with one post with no photo or link, and that post is now gone.
1. Started: @gossipdesk · Nov 3, 9:14 PM · no photo, no link · now gone · a Community Note says: misleading The earliest public post we could find. [1]
2. Spread: 190 accounts · 120 repeated it, 40 asked if it was real, 3 said it was not (we read 180 of 212 posts)
3. Who: 7 in 10 have "manon" in their name or bio Out of the 150 accounts we checked.
4. Before?: 31 of 140 were in earlier waves (Jul 2, Sep 18)
Worth knowing: 14 accounts posted the exact same sentence. "Lara was out partying while fans were stuck at the venue. Unreal."

## The first post we found
By @gossipdesk on X at 2026-11-03T21:14:00.000Z: "Heard Lara went partying the night the show got called off." [1]
Proof in it: no photo, no link.
It is no longer up (deleted, edited away, or the account went private: from outside these look the same).
Community Note (misleading): "No source for this."
The earliest public post we could find, not proof that nothing came before it.

## How it spread
212 posts from 190 accounts; we read 180 of the posts.
Of the posts read: 120 repeated it, 40 asked if it was real, 3 said it was not, 17 were about something else or unclear, 0 showed a photo, video or link. Read by a language model.

## The same words
14 accounts posted this, word for word: "Lara was out partying while fans were stuck at the venue. Unreal."

## Who
We checked 150 accounts' names and bios: 105 have "manon".

## Before
31 of 140 accounts were in earlier waves of it: 2026-07-02 (20), 2026-09-18 (11). From Pressfront's own record.

## Sources
[1] https://x.com/gossipdesk/status/1850000000000000001

We show who said what and when. We never decide who is right. Whether a post repeated, questioned or denied the story, and which side an account took, is read by a language model. Times are UTC.
